verdict.rationale: The only bulk-style capabilities in the evidence are importing many tokens at once from other authenticators, plus import/export of vault files and group-level organization. There is no documented way to select and act on many items (bulk edit, delete or move), and llms.txt explicitly states 'Public API: None', so agents cannot script operations. Missing for 10: multi-select bulk edit/delete/move of tokens or items, a scriptable API or CLI for batch operations, independent corroboration.
